user.account.external: This account comes from a directory and is managed there.
user.account.title: Account
user.form.emailRule: Enter an address such as jane@example.org
user.password.changed: Your password is changed. Your other sessions have ended.
user.password.intro: Enter your current password to choose a new one. Other sessions of your account end; this one stays.
user.password.same: Choose a password other than the current one
user.password.title: Password
user.password.tooMany: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a few minutes and try again.
user.tokens.daysRule: Enter a whole number of days from {min} to {max}
user.tokens.emptyText: Create one for each client or script, so you can revoke them one by one.
user.tokens.intro: Tokens that clients and scripts use instead of your password
user.tokens.name: Name
user.tokens.nameHint: What the token is for, such as CI or laptop
user.tokens.once: Copy the token now. It is shown only once; if you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
user.tokens.passwordFirst: You signed in with an access token. Tokens can only be created, listed and revoked after signing in with your password, so a leaked token cannot make more of itself.
user.tokens.passwordFirstTitle: Sign in with your password first
user.tokens.revokeText: Clients that use it can no longer sign in with it. This cannot be undone.
user.tokens.rule: A token signs in as you, with your roles. Use it as the password of your user name, or as a Bearer token. Tokens can only be managed after signing in with your password.
user.tokens.scopeReadText: Download and browse; no uploads or changes
user.tokens.scopeWriteText: Everything your roles allow, uploads included
user.tokens.title: Access tokens
user.tokens.usageText: Your user name stays the login; the token replaces the password. Replace <repository> and <path> with what you need.
